name: Script Generator
description: Generate a complete screenplay package from input parameters. Produces a GeneratedScriptPackage containing: ScriptDocument with metadata/cast/locations/sections, AssetCollection with character headshots/location landscapes/previs frames, and PrevisualizationPlan linking shots to assets. Enforces invariants: every named character gets a headshot, every location gets a landscape, every ShotElement gets a previs frame.

variableNode.description: Type of script (commercial, tv-episode, tv-pilot, feature-film, short-film)
Genre(s) for the script (e.g., drama, comedy, sci-fi, horror)
Visual style for asset generation (e.g., 'cinematic watercolor realism', 'noir photography')

script.description: Generate the ScriptDocument structure with metadata based on input parameters
Generate story content: cast, locations, and sections with scenes. This creates placeholder content that would typically be filled by an LLM.
Generate character headshot assets for each cast member. Rule: requireHeadshotForEachNamedCharacter = true
Generate landscape assets for each location. Rule: requireLandscapeForEachLocation = true
Generate previs-frame assets for each shot element. Rule: requirePrevisForEveryShot = true
Assemble all assets into the AssetCollection. Rule: assets.name must equal script.metadata.title
Generate the PrevisualizationPlan. Rule: every PrevisualizationShot.assetId must point to a previs-frame asset
Final validation and assembly of GeneratedScriptPackage. Enforces all invariants from ScriptGeneratorRules.

ports.name: generatedPackage
ports.description: The complete GeneratedScriptPackage with input, script, assets, and previsualizations

ports.name: validation
ports.description: Validation results including errors, warnings, and statistics

metadata.projectNotes: Script Generator Pipeline - Converts TypeScript type definitions into a working pipeline that generates complete screenplay packages (GeneratedScriptPackage) with ScriptDocument, AssetCollection, and PrevisualizationPlan. Enforces all ScriptGeneratorRules invariants.
